categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou MDK Optoelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in precision optics, semiconductor acousto-optics, semiconductor micro-nano circuits (mainly MEMS), semiconductor packaging and testing, AR/MR optical components, micro-nano optics, and smart terminal manufacturing. The company offers a diversified product portfolio including semiconductor components, biometric components, precision optical parts, and smart terminal devices, serving multiple high-tech fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor and optical technologies such as PVD, CVD, PEALD atomic layer deposition, dry and wet etching, nanoimprint lithography, chemical mechanical polishing (CMP), and vacuum plastic encapsulation. It has developed proprietary processes for ultra-thin acoustic layers, multi-channel optical layers, MicroLED full-process technology, and high-power chip packaging, integrating semiconductor manufacturing with precision optical processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading companies in consumer electronics, communication systems, smart automotive, medical devices, and industrial applications. Major clients are recognized global and domestic enterprises such as Goodix Technology, Kyocera Group, New Sound Semiconductor, Canon, Nikon, AMS, Sunny Optical, Hikvision, Foxconn, Panasonic, Ricoh, Sony, AGC, and Keyence. The company serves markets in 5G communications, AI, IoT, metaverse, low-altitude economy, and smart terminals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou and subsidiaries in Zhejiang province, Japan, and Singapore. It has significant domestic sales and exports, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 36% of main business revenue. The company maintains global cooperation and supply chains, including partnerships with international optical glass manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: MDK operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on semiconductor wafer manufacturing, precision optical component processing, semiconductor packaging and testing, and assembly of smart terminal devices. It integrates upstream semiconductor wafer processing with downstream packaging and testing, providing comprehensive manufacturing services and solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in semiconductor acousto-optics, MEMS micro-nano circuits, semiconductor packaging and testing, AR/MR components, and micro-nano optics. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 22% of revenue allocated to research, focusing on import substitution and advanced manufacturing technologies. Key R&D projects include MicroLED, Metalens, TGV glass via technology, high-frequency RF filters, and high-power chip packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision optical components, semiconductor acousto-optic devices, MEMS circuits, semiconductor packaging and testing services, and smart terminal products. The company operates mainly on a direct sales model with long-term framework agreements and order-based production, emphasizing product customization and integrated solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MDK is positioned as a leading domestic player in the optical optoelectronics and semiconductor sectors, particularly in niche fields such as precision optics, semiconductor acousto-optics, MEMS, and packaging/testing. It competes with international and domestic companies in high-tech semiconductor manufacturing and optical component processing, leveraging its integrated technology platform and strong customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 485.5 million, a 51.38% increase year-over-year, driven by ramped production of 12-inch ultrasonic fingerprint chips and image sensors. Despite revenue growth, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 101.8 million. Total assets increased by 33.43% to over RMB 3 billion, reflecting significant investment in fixed assets and construction projects. R&D expenses accounted for 22.19% of revenue, underscoring a growth strategy focused on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MDK emphasizes its integrated technology platform combining semiconductor manufacturing and precision optical processing, enabling customized, high-performance products with advanced features such as ultra-thin acoustic layers, multi-channel optical solutions, and high-power chip packaging. Its competitive differentiation lies in proprietary manufacturing processes, strong R&D capabilities, and close collaboration with leading global customers, enabling it to provide one-stop, high-quality solutions that support emerging applications in AI, 5G, smart automotive, and AR/MR.
